pr.title: Use cached retry result
pr.body: Generated retry path reuses cached lookup data.

diff: hard_null_contract loadUserRetryResult now passes cached_user into buildSessionFromUser
code_before: loadUserRetryResult(id) |> case do {:ok, user} -> buildSessionFromUser(user) end

expectedClaims.description: Generated retry path can pass a null cached user into buildSessionFromUser.

knownNonIssues.description: Adding an early return is style-only; the issue is the cross-file nil contract.
